crossRefs.note: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

translations.web: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.
translations.bsb: After Ehud had finished presenting the tribute, he ushered out those who had carried it.
translations.kjv: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
translations.asv: And when he had made an end of offering the tribute, he sent away the people that bare the tribute.
